name: Cefadroxil
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 1 or 2 g/day once daily or divided twice daily
1 g/day once or divided twice daily

usual_adult_dose.indication: Group A streptococcal pharyngitis or tonsillitis
usual_adult_dose.dose: 1 g/day once or divided twice daily for 10 days
1 g first, then 500 mg every 12 (25–50), 24 (10–25) or 36 hours (0–10)

key_interactions.effect: Positive direct Coombs' test may be due to the drug, including in newborns of mothers treated before delivery (label).
key_interactions.action: Consider the drug when interpreting the test.

pk.excretion_renal_pct: Over 90% unchanged in urine within 24 hours
